name: jumpcloud
label: JumpCloud
description: Manage JumpCloud users, devices, groups and applications.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: The administrator API key from My API Key in the Admin Portal.

region.label: Region
region.description: The data center your JumpCloud organization lives in.

orgId.label: Organization ID
orgId.description: Only needed if you manage several organizations (multi-tenant admin). Find it in the Admin Portal under Settings > Organization Profile. Leave empty otherwise.

find_user_by_employee_id.label: Search User by Employee ID
find_user_by_employee_id.description: Find the JumpCloud user with an exact employee ID, for example one sent by your HR system.

employeeId.label: Employee ID
employeeId.description: The exact employee ID stored on the user in JumpCloud. Matching is case-sensitive.
